title: Marvel's Series
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Marvel's Series was so successful that it continued for 107 issues, adapting all three films and introducing scores of new characters. The writers and artists had to be careful not to infringe on the main story lines of the films and characters. John Byrne (front) presents a scene just out of the camera's eye as a stormtrooper blasts C-3PO in a corridor of Cloud City, shown in an overview (back) by Al Williamson and Carlos Garzon.
